comment: The output voltage is 5V or 10V depending on the OUT RANGE switch, so no single range is written into the port fields; the switch's own line carries it. A<B>C means A below B and B above C: the module never compares A directly with C. The lamp above each output follows that output. The three bicolour lamps below the inputs show the input voltages, green positive and red negative; they have no ParamWidget or PortWidget, so no click can reach them.
